question: The Asiatic lion population largely resides in the protected park area of _______.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Gir National Park'.**** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• Asiatic lions are slightly smaller than African lions.
 
• At present Asiatic lions are naturally found in India only in Gir National Park and Wildlife Sanctuary.
 
• The Asiatic lion is a population of Panthera leo Leo that today survives in the wild only in India. 
 
• There are only around 600 Asiatic lions left in the wild, living in the Indian state of Gujarat, Western India. The population largely live in the protected park area of the Gir Forest National Park and Sanctuary.
